programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. The Alphablocks have a battle of the bands to see which is best.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.sub-title: We're All Friends: Series 14: 1. Get Set Gardening
programme.desc: [AD] Justin gets green-fingered with his new friend, while Mr Tumble helps Grandad look after the garden.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Preschool series. The Teletubbies bounce on the Tubby Bouncy. Po bounces as high as a cloud, then Laa-Laa and Dipsy bounce higher and Tinky Winky bounces highest of all.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers go on an eco quest to find out all about shells.

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: [AD] When a rogue ball destroys Mr Parks’s competition-ready bug hotel, Evie, Taran and Jaz help him rebuild it using a combination of football skills and teamwork.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: Grace shows off three amazing machines that are all like animals. She goes for a ride in a vehicle like a shark, shows off a machine that flies like a bird and goes for a drive in a big robot insect.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: It's the first day of Pup School. Dodge overcomes his first day nerves as he meets lots of new friends. The pups settle into their class activities with their new teacher Miss Collie.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: [AD] Ginger joins the baby Pea-Rexes on their expedition to find dinner.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.sub-title: Series 2: 27. The Tale of Fred Snail
programme.desc: [AD] Animated series. Benjamin gets a pet snail, but his friends can't see the appeal, especially when it attracts the attention of Old Brown!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: [AD] The Squirrels meet a Scrufflelump in the woods, and despite Duggee’s reservations, take him in. But they soon learn the responsibilities of taking care of a pet.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: [AD] Vida and friends move a piano all the way across Sweetwood to save Pippen’s concert!

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: [AD] Supertato is delighted when Evil Pea comes to his birthday party, but Carrot is suspicious. Soon Evil Pea unleashes the Mini Peas, who try to steal Supertato’s birthday present.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy promises to go camping with the ducklings, but he wants to watch football instead. During half-time, Weasy attempts to finish camping as quickly as possible.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: [AD] Ted the bus wants to be faster, and Mojo swops every top to try to make it happen. But it’s Bo’s homemade rocket that gives Ted the boost he needs... all the way into space!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: [AD] The Heelers take a long riverside walk, but Bingo’s legs are tired and she wants a piggyback. To distract her, Mum and Dad invent fun games and get her little legs moving again!

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: [AD] The fearsome Great Gnanna Gnome has a case of bottom-fungal-itis. Zog and the doctors must figure out how to treat the mushroom without incurring Gnanna's anger.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: [AD] Penny brings a dinosaur fossil to the nursery, while Bonnie and Hamish plan a secret dino dance. And mysterious footprints have Penny wondering if there’s a real dino on the island.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: [AD] The Brooklyn-Bells are away, so Waffle is at Angela’s kennels. He makes a new friend called Pepper but misses his family and barks non-stop. Jess knows who can help, Mrs Hobbs!

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: [AD] Finn’s magic show goes wrong, until Rafi makes a wish to help him. With Ruby’s help, they fix the chaos, and Finn proves he can shine on his own. Rafi realises that friends sometimes need space.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.sub-title: Series 2 - Spring: 5. It's Time to Build a Bug Hotel
programme.desc: JoJo, Gran Gran and Cynthia build a bug hotel and welcome some new residents. JoJo learns that different insects are attracted to different materials in the bug hotel.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: [AD] Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures. Today, they attempt to take photographs of birds.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: [AD] During a meteor shower, a giant boulder drops from the sky and blocks the double doors leading to the Clangers' living cave. Can the Clangers invent something to help move it?

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: [AD] MeMo and BaBa have fun playing tickle chase, but BaBa wants to stop playing. With the help of the Yummies, MeMo learns there is a time and place for tickles.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Children's programme. The Pontipines and the Wottingers are out for a walk in the garden when Mrs Pontipine spots the Ninky Nonk through her binoculars.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.sub-title: A-E: Andy Day - Can I Join Your Club?
programme.desc: Andy Day invites you to join the CBeebies House Club for a welcoming Bedtime Story.

programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. When the Alphablocks' party is a flop, superhero Exciting X comes to the rescue.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.sub-title: We're All Friends: Series 14: 2. Nature Gathering
programme.desc: [AD] Maddie joins her friends at the park to explore nature, while Mr Tumble gets messy trying to paint a picture.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Preschool series. Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po run around in circles in the Home Dome. The Noo-noo joins in and the Teletubbies have fun chasing.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers go on an eco quest to find out all about wild flower meadows.

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: [AD] Elvis has forgotten his trainers and has to wear a pair with laces, but he can’t tie them without his gran’s help. He needs to quickly learn to tie them himself if he wants to get a PB.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, Grace shows off three incredible machines that all belong on the beach.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: Dodge is eager to win the Class Star award, but how will he outshine Cherry the superstar at everything? Dodge discovers the real key to winning Class Star is by trying his best.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: [AD] Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes must teach a lost baby Bokchoydactyl how to fly.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: [AD] Tracker finds trapped creatures in an underground tunnel after falling into a sinkhole.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.sub-title: Series 2: 28. The Tale of the Fish Out of Water
programme.desc: [AD] Animated series. When Old Brown catches their friend Jack Sharp, Peter, Lily and Benjamin must race to return this fish-out-of-water to the lake!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: [AD] The Squirrels lose Tag in the Clubhouse but to find him they’re going to have to figure out where the Lost Property room is.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: [AD] Sunny is nervous that Baby Mouse will get hurt when she starts to take her first steps.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: [AD] Evil Pea thinks the Veggies won’t like it when she covers the supermarket in ice, but instead they have the best snow day ever, so she creates a giant snowball to ruin their fun.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy finds a box full of magic props but won't share, upsetting Spicy, who wants to be a magician too. Spicy is sad - until she discovers the Farm of the Future's latest invention.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: [AD] Nori and Dot are stuck in a treehouse without a door. How can Mojo and Bo get them out? By sending the treehouse flying across town, that’s how!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: [AD] Bingo finds a toy turtle at the playground and wants to take him home.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: [AD] Bingo is convinced that she has ruined Mother's Day when she drops Mum’s breakfast in bed on the floor. But Bluey helps make amends by putting on a play about how Mum and Dad first met.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: [AD] Gadabout and Pearl need Zog's help to catch a stink beetle for an urgent cure. Little do they know, Zog has become a taxi for the gnomes.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: [AD] PC Plum uses Ava’s doubling machine by mistake and multiplies all his recycling. But with Dr Ollie’s help, it becomes Cyclo the Recycling Robot, giving the children lots of fun.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: [AD] Waffle is at Mrs Hobbs’ house until the Brooklyn-Bells return from holiday. He acts like a cat to please her and helpfully washes up his bowl, but accidentally leaves the taps on.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: [AD] Rafi wishes for a real dinosaur at the museum. Slurpy the triceratops causes chaos, but Aunty T restores everything. She admits dinosaurs and museums are magic, which makes Rafi smile.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.sub-title: Series 2 - Spring: 6. It's Time to Visit the Market
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran visit the busy market to buy fish and end up helping their friends. JoJo learns that the market is like a family – the people there are kind and look out for each other.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: [AD] Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures. Sarah needs some new shoes, but picks out a very unusual pair.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: [AD] Major invents a Clanger finder, but it isn't very useful - it always finds the Clanger who is holding it. He needs a bigger challenge, so Granny makes a suggestion.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: [AD] BaBa becomes friends with a Tweetie. MeMo would like a Tweetie friend too. At Play Time, MeMo befriends a new toy called MeMo Dog. Yummy Dog also wants to be MeMo Dog’s friend.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Children's programme. The ball is bouncing through the garden and lands straight on Upsy Daisy's bed. She tucks the ball in so it can have a rest.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: It's time to say goodnight with Kylie Minogue as she reads a timeless tale especially for you!

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Herman the Postman is going on holidays. He has left his round to the young Steart O'Meara, who hasn't yet encountered all of Garfield's devilish traps...

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: It's winter and Garfield and his friends, Odie and Nermal, are competing for the price of "the best Christmas carolling singer". There are cookies at stake!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon's cousin has passed away and has left his fortune to Jon and Doc Boy. But there's one condition: the one who will spend an entire night in a spooky manor will be the one to inherit everything.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: After Garfield slightly changes the recipe of Odie's birthday cake, it comes to life and spreads panic in town!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield has been mean to Odie again. Left in the garden, he's taken in by a neighbour, Nathan. Odie is happy with this new friendship, but he soon discovers that Garfield wasn't that bad after all...

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield takes us through the ages to tell us the history of dogs. As we know, he has a poor opinion of them, but an incident will make him change his mind. After all, all dogs are not useless!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield is bored. He has nothing to do. Well, not exactly: watching Odie and the squirrels in the garden, there's fun ahead after all!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Eddie Gourmand has built a super attraction park, made completely out of cheese. Squeak and his friends beg Garfield to take them there but with Harry working as a security guard, it won't be easy!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Pooky has disappeared again, but this time, it's Nermal who finds it. He is willing to give it back to him at one condition: Garfield has to be really nice to Nermal for the rest of the day!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield's cat instincts push him to climb on a tree. But how will he get down? Everyone tries to give him a hand, but they end up stuck in that tree! Now he's out on a limb; who will save him?

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Nermal doesn't believe in super heroes. Garfield does and he tries desperately to convince him. Even if that means disguising himself as Ultra Powerful Guy.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield receives a strange helmet which lets him read everyone's thoughts. He even catches aliens' conversations who are just about to conquer Earth! Garfield has to stop this plot immediately!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: After Odie dreams of being a super hero, Garfield mocks him for it. But when Garfield really gets into trouble, Odie puts his grudges aside and flies off to help him. And this time he REALLY flies!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Nermal makes a bet with Garfield: if Garfield manages not to eat for a whole hour, he won't see Nermal for a whole month. Will Garfield be victorious ?

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: There is a space invasion under Jon Arbuckle's roof, and the aliens are looking very much like Garfield's favourite meal: lasagnas.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Squeak and his mice family have taken up residence in Garfield's house, to Jon's despair, who will deprive Garfield of lasagnas if he doesn't turn things back to normal.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield's favourite restaurant, Vito's Pizzeria, is in jeopardy. The evil Mama Meany wants to buy it to expand his own restaurant, with the PizzaGrand 7000 capable of making ten pizzas a minute.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: A mother bluebird is locked in a neighbourhood garage, so who will care for her eggs? That's a job for Garfield, who is sometimes quite a mother hen.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Odie is found by Al the Dogcatcher with no license on his collar so he puts him in the city pound with other stray dogs. Garfield will do everything to get his friend back.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Odie falls in love with a brush. Garfield becomes a little bit jealous about that and decides to make the brush disappear.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon finds an old accordion. It's unbearable for Garfield who totally dislikes this music. He will do everything to get rid of it.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon has won a live turkey in a raffle and wants to prepare it for dinner, but he can't make up his mind to eat it. Neither can Garfield!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield and Odie are watching a horror movie... They're scared. Jon, who has forgotten his key, is knocking at the door. The two pets won't let him in until he's proven his identity.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield is angry. A fake, secret agent is trying to steal the show and his popularity among his friends.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: It's Halloween! Garfield goes trick or treating and disguises himself as a scary Catzilla. But the real Catzilla has just escaped from the city zoo and will spread panic in Garfield's neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Odie has been thrown out of the house by Garfield and spends all night outside on his own. An alien crashes his UFO in the garden and loses a key part necessary to get back home!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Nermal's owner has gone away on vacation and Jon has offered to look after Nermal while he's gone. Watch out, everybody! The cutest kitten in the world (he says so himself) is coming over for a week!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Who has stolen Pooky? After a night drying on the clothes line, Pooky has disappeared, and Garfield can't sleep without him.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: It's night-time and the full moon and the alignment of the planets are having a strange effect on Odie.
